# FORM — The Design Index

> FORM is an independent interactive design index created by Prakhar Indoria in India. It explores one Mumbai Indians story through 37 distinct brand-inspired design philosophies.

## Creator

- Name: Prakhar Indoria
- Role: Creator of FORM — The Design Index
- LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/in/prakharindoria/
- Website: https://form-design.in/

## Explore

- [Home](https://form-design.in/): Introduction and featured community favourite.
- [Collection](https://form-design.in/collection/): All 37 visual studies.
- [Rankings](https://form-design.in/rankings/): Editorial rankings and live People's Choice voting results.
- [Sitemap](https://form-design.in/sitemap.xml): Canonical URLs for all public studies.

## Notes

- The brand-inspired artwork and rankings are an independent editorial design experiment, not official brand products or endorsements.
- All studies use the same Mumbai Indians captaincy and championship narrative.
- Editorial scores are subjective. People's Choice rankings come from anonymous public votes and may change.
- No account is required to browse the collection.
